user_query: I want to build a portfolio website and showcase my completed work projects.

TaskList.description: Gather details of completed work projects including title, image URL, framework used, and link to each project.
Format the project information into a presentable layout suitable for a portfolio website.
Choose a website building platform or framework to create the portfolio.
Implement the formatted project information into the chosen platform or framework.
Test the website for proper display of all projects and links.
Launch the portfolio website for public access.
